chart.title: Time women and men spend on unpaid care and domestic work
chart.subtitle: Average hours per day that women and men aged 15 and older spend on unpaid care and domestic work.
chart.note: Unpaid care and domestic work includes: food preparation, dishwashing, upkeep of a dwelling, laundry, ironing, gardening, caring for pets, shopping, servicing and repair of personal and household goods, childcare, and care of the sick, elderly or disabled household members, among others.
chart.citation: United Nations Statistics Division and UN Women
